quotes.name: Adash Stanley
quotes.quote: The part that feels constant is the work itself. When the lineup shifts or the assignment changes, the game still asks the same thing — show up, do your job, don't make it about you. The record sits there at 5-1 and it doesn't care who's carrying it. That's what I hold onto.

interviews.raw: {"answer":"When the rotation shifts, the thing I carry that stays the same is the work itself. I've seen enough seasons to know roles move around, but the steadiness comes from showing up the same way every day. That's what holds the building up, not the record. The record's just a scoreboard.
